features: Consolidates Projector Live Feed Link, screen resolution/layout settings and remote feed controls into one Live Screen Control page
Adds clearly visible one-link projector workflow with Copy Link, Open Preview and Generate/Regenerate controls
Same projector link can be remotely switched among Holding, Judges, Competitors, Scoring, Callbacks, Finalists, Final Ranking and Winner Podium
Keeps screen format, density, custom resolution, auto paging and page delay controls on the same operator screen
Winner Reveal now renders as a real Top 5 podium with 1st highest center, 2nd/3rd adjacent and 4th/5th outer positions
Winner podium progressively retains already revealed placements for 5th through 1st reveal flow
Winner podium queries competitor photos and country flags; missing or broken photos leave clean empty space and never block results
Participant projection renderer now honors page parameter for multi-page remote rotation
No scoring calculation, results or official BDC points logic changed
No Staging or Production deployment performed
